prompt: Composition: Repeated item tiles with shared metadata alignment, category headings, search and filters. Build for this brief: A specialist shop; shoppers inspect objects, compare details and buy. Set headings in Archivo and reading text in Inter; grotesque heading with neutral interface text. Use Apricot and Cypress: page #FFF9F3, text #293C32, accent #A84218, secondary surface #E4EFE7, text on accent #FFFFFF. Use body 14px, heading 36px, line height 1.75, reading measure at most 40ch, gap 8px, content width at most 960px and item radius 0px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
